name: Fall For Me Again
source:
You play as a young woman who loses her beauty after breaking a pact with a witch by falling in love with her boyfriend, Perrie. Struggling to prove your identity to him while keeping your secret hidden, you navigate workplace drama, jealousy, and emotional tension. 

Every choice you make brings you closer to either revealing the truth – or losing his trust forever. Will love conquer all, or will the truth shatter everything?

[From [url=https://minimixo.itch.io/fall-for-me-again]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一名年轻女子，她因违反与女巫的契约而爱上了男友佩里，从而失去了美丽。你努力向他证明你的身份，同时隐藏你的秘密，你要应对职场戏剧、嫉妒和紧张的情绪。

你做出的每一个选择都会让你更接近揭露真相——或者永远失去他的信任。爱情会征服一切，还是真相会粉碎一切？

[来自[url=https://minimixo.itch.io/fall-for-me-again]Itch.io[/url]]
